evidence.why: Sentinel handling writes stat, whereas both format switches read ent.

facts.rationale: Corrects the implication that sentinel normalization suppresses presentation-layout computation; the cleared output fields are not the switch inputs.
facts.value: If ent->iconAddr is 0xffffffff, the helper clears stat->bannerFormat, stat->iconFormat, and stat->iconSpeed and resets the layout cursor to zero, without changing ent. Banner and icon switches still decode ent, so recognized stored formats can produce asset offsets and a nonzero offsetData even with the absent-address sentinel. Absent or unsupported formats receive 0xffffffff offsets without consuming storage. A banner TLUT exists only for C8 banners; one shared trailing icon TLUT exists if any icon is C8.

evidence.why: Input guards, access rejection, mutation order, and immediate-failure release.
Directory persistence, successful copy switching, error paths, conditional release, and callback clearing/invocation.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact validation and cross-file ownership branches, including conditional callback cleanup and mutation-before-scheduling failure behavior.
facts.value: Rejects out-of-range file numbers, non-sentinel icon addresses at or beyond CARD_READ_SIZE, and non-sentinel comment addresses whose system-block remainder exceeds CARD_SYSTEM_BLOCK_SIZE - CARD_COMMENT_SIZE with CARD_RESULT_FATAL_ERROR. Acquisition failures propagate immediately; access failures release the acquired control block without a public-file fallback. Presentation metadata and the directory timestamp are mutated before __CARDUpdateDir; immediate scheduling failure releases the block but this function performs no mutation rollback. Successful scheduling delegates completion to directory erase/write callbacks. Successful write completion switches and mirrors the current directory copy. Those callbacks release the control block only when card->apiCallback is null, then clear and invoke a non-null saved eraseCallback with channel and result; erase/write errors also reach this conditional cleanup and notification path.
